carousel.title: Other agencies left them struggling.
carousel.text: Two parents, two sets of needs, and a couple of agencies over the years that never got it right.

carousel.title: MCM let them rest for the first time.
carousel.text: They were "finally able to sleep at night knowing my parents are finally receiving the in-home care on a daily basis they desperately needed."

carousel.title: The care covered the whole picture.
carousel.text: Not just presence, but oversight: "From their unwavering compassion to the monitoring of their daily life to the administration and monitoring of their medications."

carousel.title: MCM went past what they hoped for.
carousel.text: In David's words, MCM "not only met our expectations but exceeded them beyond our wildest dreams."
Thank you Medical Consulting and Management for making the life of my parents the best it could be under the most difficult of circumstances!
